target.interpretation: internal and transductive; not biological validation

rules: No model training, reclustering, parameter tuning, TEST evaluation or VCF rescan.
The 10-individual and 5-effective-group floors are conservative decision rules, not biological thresholds or power theorems.
Historical rare_density and carrier_density count ALT and must not be described as minor-allele burden.
USABLE_EXPLORATORY never authorizes downstream training automatically and never implies independent validation.
After this audit the internal target is either retained only for description or closed; no further internal audit cycle is opened.
